描述_EN: chinese jade-carvers were equally skilful working with hardstones such as chalcedony and agate, as here. noblemen in ancient china strung together beads, tubes, rings and plaques to form pendant sets and wore them as personal ornaments, a practice highly praised by confucius and his contemporaries. this small ring is made from moss agate, so-called because of the natural moss-like pattern in the stone.
描述_ZN: 年，中国的玉石雕刻家们同样熟练地使用玉髓和玛瑙等硬石，如图。 年¥古代中国的贵族们将珠子、管子、戒指和牌子串在一起，形成吊坠组合，作为个人装饰品佩戴，这种做法受到了孔子和他同时代人的高度赞扬。 年¥这个小戒指是由玛瑙苔藓制成的，所谓的苔藓是因为石头上的天然苔藓图案。
